Can I cancel if my plans change?
Every tour can be cancelled for free. How late you can cancel differs per tour; the exact cut-off is on the tour page and in your confirmation email. No forms, no questions asked.
Do I have to pay in full now?
Usually not. Most tours reserve with a small deposit and you settle the rest later or on arrival, depending on the tour. A few tours charge in full or take nothing at booking; the tour page always states exactly how it works before you commit.
How far ahead should I book on Curaçao?
A few days is usually enough. The Klein Curaçao boats and the dolphin lagoon fill first, especially December to April and around holidays; land tours often have room a day ahead.
What happens if the operator has to cancel?
Weather and safety calls happen on real islands. When a tour is called off, you choose: your money back in full, or a free move to a new date.
Not sure which tour fits?
Message us on WhatsApp with who's coming and what you like. You get a short list of picks that fit, not a catalog dump.
About tours in Curaçao

Top things to do

Klein Curaçao is the trip people fly home talking about: an uninhabited island reached by a crossing of 45 minutes to 1 hour 45 minutes, with a beach that outruns every photo of it and a shipwreck you can walk to. Catamarans, motorboats, and speedboats make the run daily. Closer in, the west coast is calm-water territory: snorkel bays, the Blue Room cave, and beach-hopping routes past Kenepa's lookout. The east side answers with dust and horsepower on buggy and quad trails toward Cave of Doom and the ostrich farm. In between sit sunset sails off the south coast, jet ski runs past Willemstad's painted waterfront, and a lagoon where you can swim with dolphins. First visit? Start with one boat day, one land day, and one sunset.

Planning your trip

Boat days to Klein Curaçao leave early, usually before 7:00, and are back before dinner; sunset cruises run 2.5 to 3 hours, and most land tours fit inside an afternoon. Curaçao sits south of the hurricane belt and the trade wind keeps the heat workable, so tours run year-round. December to April is high season, and the popular boats fill first: book those a few days ahead, more around holidays. Arriving by cruise ship? Check a tour's meeting point against your terminal before you book; many departures are minutes from the Willemstad quays. Every price you see includes taxes and fees, and a deposit is usually all it takes to hold your spot.

Why book with Island Tours

Island Tours is built on Curaçao by people who grew up here. We don't list everything; we pick the operators we'd put our own family on, ride the tours ourselves, and write every description from experience. The price you see is the full price. Most tours reserve with a small deposit, so you're not paying for the whole holiday up front, and every tour can be cancelled for free, no forms, no questions asked; the exact cut-off is on each tour page. And when you're standing on a dock at 6:45 wondering where the boat is, we answer on WhatsApp, 08:00 to 20:00, from the same island you're calling about.
